readOnlyMode.title: Read-only mode
readOnlyMode.description: When enabled, story_* tools refuse all writes (AC updates, scope changes, discovered-work issues). Agents receive the proposed change back so they can hand it to a human instead. Note: this only governs the story_* tools; to block ALL agent writes including the predefined create_issue/update_issue tools, use a token from a read-only account (see docs/permissions.md).
